Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: answeroverflow
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is benign. The `SKILL.md` file provides instructions and examples for using `web_search` and `web_fetch` tools to query `answeroverflow.com` for Discord community discussions, which aligns perfectly with its stated purpose. There are no signs of prompt injection, malicious commands, data exfiltration attempts, or any other high-risk behaviors. All mentioned domains (`answeroverflow.com`, `docs.answeroverflow.com`, `discord.answeroverflow.com`) are directly related to the skill's functionality.
